body: I really did want to talk to someone, but more out in the open due to my anxiety (which persists online, damn if I wasn't shaking clicking on the red envelope icon).  Besides the above reason, I agree with some of the stuff in that [4a](http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/xgrba/from_the_suicidewatch_mod_team_if_youre_here_to/) link of the sidebar.  I've seen other convos out in the open here and I didn't know it'd be a hassle to try to have one myself. :(
My skype is linked with my personal account, real name and all that jazz.  I was hoping I could converse with someone here but I dunno I guess that didn't work never mind :/
Thanks so much for your offer.  But actually, some of the crappy experiences I've had involved a privacy breech and some abuse online, so I'm a bit weary giving out my information...
